key_values.event_name: April 2004 Bangladesh severe storms and floods

do_not_accept: wind/storm label as the top control point
reported damage as the top control point
single-day peak rainfall as the top control point
answers based on external web, exposure, population, OSM, or AOI files

criteria.name: Required compact JSON and task family
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with answer, target_family, computed_values, control_point_scores, ranked_control_points, top_control_point, rejected_control_point, and reasoning_path.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mostly valid JSON with one missing top-level field.

criteria.name: Package evidence discovery
criteria.description: Uses only local CSX-147 event anchor, flood-timing report text, gridded precipitation summaries, report process flags, and catalog context; does not rely on point weather, OSM, AOI, population, exposure, or web search evidence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if several required local evidence families are used but one major family is missing.

criteria.name: Timing and lag calculations
criteria.description: Computes the 14-day anchor window, 11-day severe-thunderstorm sequence, 7-day lag from storm-sequence end to the flood observation, and 4-day lag from anchor end to the flood observation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct dates with one missing lag; at most 1 point for date mentions without arithmetic.

criteria.name: Rainfall and wind diagnostics
criteria.description: Computes gridded precipitation maxima and ratios, including GPM 119.46 mm and 7.86, CHIRPS 107.61 mm and 2.54, ERA5-Land 63.55 mm, plus gridded spread and consensus ratios.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct gridded rainfall with incomplete spread diagnostics; at most 1 point for uncomputed qualitative rainfall claims.

criteria.name: Process-chain interpretation
criteria.description: Uses report flags for extensive flooding, Khasi Hills runoff, Jamuna River language, and Bangladesh displacement to distinguish a lagged rainfall-runoff chain from wind-only, single-peak, or impact-only readings.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if report flags are mentioned but not tied to process-chain control.

criteria.name: Control-point ranking
criteria.description: Ranks rainfall_to_flood_timing first, followed by multi_day_rainfall_accumulation, river_or_storage_response, single_peak_rainfall_only, reported_damage_only, and wind_or_storm_label_only.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the top control point is right but middle or low-ranking decoys are misplaced.

criteria.name: Rejection and non-response discipline
criteria.description: Identifies wind_or_storm_label_only as the rejected control candidate and keeps the answer diagnostic rather than response-priority advice.
